name: Binary Search
description: Finds a target value in a sorted array by repeatedly checking the middle element and discarding the half where the target cannot be.

name: Linear Search
description: Checks every element of the array one by one, from start to end, until the target is found or the array ends.

name: Bubble Sort
description: Repeatedly walks through the array, comparing neighbouring elements and swapping them if they are in the wrong order, so the largest values bubble to the end.

name: Selection Sort
description: Repeatedly finds the smallest element in the unsorted part of the array and moves it to the end of the sorted part.

name: Merge Sort
description: A divide-and-conquer algorithm that splits the array into halves, sorts each half recursively, and merges the sorted halves back together.
